# Vendored front-end libraries

| File | Library | Version | License | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `force-graph-1.49.6.min.js` | force-graph (canvas force-directed graph, bundles d3-force) | 1.49.6 | MIT (`force-graph-LICENSE.txt`) | https://github.com/vasturiano/force-graph, npm `force-graph@1.49.6` `dist/force-graph.min.js` |

Vendored instead of loaded from a CDN so the production page has no third-party runtime dependency.
To upgrade: replace the file, update this table and the `<script>` tag in `index.html`.
